promptEs: En Si mayor, ¿en qué grado resuelve V/ii?
promptEn: In B major, which degree does V/ii resolve to?
explanationEs: En Si mayor, V/ii es Sol♯7 y resuelve en Do♯m (ii). Su tercera es la sensible de Do♯m y sube un semitono al resolver.
explanationEn: In B major, V/ii is G♯7 and it resolves to C♯m (ii). Its third is the leading tone of C♯m and rises a semitone when it resolves.
